# Config keys

The per-package settings an app can set: each package's manifest `configuration`. `crouton config` asks for them when the app extends the package (defaults in CI). For the top-level `crouton.config.js` shape (`collections`, `targets`, `dialect`) see the [CLI reference](/generation/cli-reference).

## crouton-bookings

Answers land in `crouton.config.js → features.<alias>` and `runtimeConfig.croutonBookings`.

| Key | Type | Default | Runtime config | Options | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email.enabled` | boolean | `false` |  |  | Send booking confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups via email. |
| `bookingModes` | multiselect | `["slots"]` |  | `slots`, `inventory` | How resources can be booked. |

## crouton-maps

Answers land in `crouton.config.js → features.<alias>` and `runtimeConfig.maps`.

| Key | Type | Default | Runtime config | Options | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `style` | select | `"liberty"` | public | `liberty`, `positron`, `bright`, `dark`, `fiord` | Default OpenFreeMap style for all maps. Keyless — no token required. Can be overridden per component or via MAPS_STYLE env var. |
| `geocodingUrl` | string | `"https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org"` | server |  | Base URL for the Nominatim geocoding server. Set via NOMINATIM_URL env var. Defaults to the public OpenStreetMap instance; point at a self-hosted instance to avoid rate limits. |

## crouton-sales

Answers land in `crouton.config.js → features.<alias>` and `runtimeConfig.croutonSales`.

| Key | Type | Default | Runtime config | Options | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `print.enabled` | boolean | `false` | server |  | Enable receipt printing to thermal printers. Requires network-connected printers. |
